## Fixed

- Discover application windows from the focused and main window elements when the published window list is empty or incomplete.
- Admit independent custom and borderless AXWindow roots through matching WindowServer ownership and parent checks, without application-name exceptions or an AXMain-capability requirement. Preserve modal, child, utility and system-surface exclusions.
- Preserve independent window identities across overlapping frames, focus changes and missing window lists. Apply newer confirmed focus before eligibility and update minimized state for already admitted untitled roots.
- Retire windows that become native children without preventing later rediscovery, and refresh stale WindowServer data before a destructive parent verdict.

## Verification

The reviewed source passed 1006 local tests, 241 constrained-executor lifecycle tests, 13 Python tests, 24 Node.js tests and 3 WindowLab checks. Regression and mutation checks cover the review findings; arm64 Release and deployment checks pass. Source CI: https://github.com/sashokey/properwm/actions/runs/43108787735 . The release workflow reruns tests and package verification for this version before publication.

Live post-fix validation with the reported WoW session has not been completed.
